mapper.select: SELECT doi.platform_order_id, doi.sales_record_number, doi.platform_sign, doit.id, doit.order_id, doit.item_id, doit.item_name, doit.specifics, doit.sku_no, doit.erp_order_item_id, doit.amount_after FROM "dmp_order_item" doit LEFT JOIN dmp_order_info doi on doit.order_id = doi."id" where doit.amount_after = 0 and doit.is_gift = 2 and doi.platform_sign = '管易云' and doit.refresh_status = false order by doit.id ASC limit 10000
